cards.hint: Recall the tiny per-acre figure noted with the doubling in size.
cards.quote: For roughly 4 cents an acre, the United States doubled its size, expanding the nation westward.
cards.stem: What was the approximate price paid for each acre of land?

cards.hint: Focus on the two negotiators named at the start of the offer story.
cards.quote: negotiators Robert Livingston and James Monroe were authorized to pay France up to $10 million
cards.stem: Which men were authorized to pay for the port and the Floridas?

cards.hint: Remember the formal cession document named at the end.
cards.quote: The Louisiana Purchase Agreement is made up of the Treaty of Cession and the two conventions regarding the financial aspects of the transaction.
cards.stem: Which agreement plus two conventions formed the purchase deal?
